item.title: A woman's tribute to her late husband could bring a YMCA to the city of Quincy
item.description: A Quincy property owner is working to bring a 24/7 YMCA to the city — honoring her late husband's love for the community by investing in its future.

item.title: Students see their artwork return to Hartsfield Elementary after crosswalk removal
item.description: Students at Hartsfield Elementary are seeing their artwork again after a mural removed in the fall returns as a playground fence wind screen.

item.title: Wakulla Senior Center crochet class donates handmade blankets and hats to newborns in the county
item.description: The items go to the Wakulla Pregnancy Center, where new mothers receive a blanket when they have a positive pregnancy test — a way to symbolize the start of a new journey.
